message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: In Tongjiang county, on Feb 25 2015, defendant (named 向某某) together with villagers He, Cheng, Zou etc each held firearms with gunpowder to go hunting in village area. During hunting, Zou accidentally injured He. After incident, police seized the gun from 向某某. The gun is a front-loading non-standard firearm, recognized as a gun, with killing power.

Thus crimes: illegal possession of firearms (non-standard) and illegal hunting (illegal possession of gun for hunting). The list includes "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" (illegal possession, private storage of firearms, ammunition) and "非法狩猎" (illegal hunting). Also possibly "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" is used earlier for similar cases. The facts mention they used gun for hunting, which is illegal hunting. So we need both charges: illegal possession of firearms and illegal hunting.

Check list: "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" is a label. "非法狩猎" is also a label. So answer should be "[罪名]非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药;非法狩猎<eoa>"

Make sure format: [罪名]...<eoa>. Provide JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
